incident-bot: INC-1839990001 triggered: elevated OOM rate on pool=gpu-infer-b, severity=sev2, paging oncall
Priya S.: picked up, what cluster?
Marco L.: joining, seeing multiple kube restarts on gpu-infer-b pods in us-west-2
Priya S.: grabbing logs from pod gpu-infer-b-03 now
Priya S.: logs from pod gpu-infer-b-03:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] prefill: seq_len=150000 tokens, kv_cache=42.1GiB
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] cuda: out of memory while allocating 1.8GiB
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Aborted (core dumped)
```
Ikuo N.: model variant looks like custom-70b-q4, passthrough system prompts allowed on this tenant
Marco L.: impact: bursts of OOMKills -> container restarts -> node-level flaps when repeated
Priya S.: customer impact: 3 tickets reporting chat timeouts / session resets, a small fraction of requests 502/504s
Marco L.: hypothesis: unbounded long-context prefill (system + history) exceeding 100k tokens; runtime currently lets passthrough through for some enterprise customers
Priya S.: immediate mitigations proposed:
- set per-pool runtime limit `prefill_max_tokens=50000`
- enable `reject_on_prefill_oom=true` to avoid retry storms
- route requests flagged for over-limit to a fallback model with smaller KV cache
- cordon/drain the flappy nodes to prevent noisy-neighbor effects
Priya S.: can someone flip the flag for gpu-infer-b?
deploy-bot: Applying runtime config to pool=gpu-infer-b: prefill_max_tokens=50000, reject_on_prefill_oom=true
deploy-bot: Change applied (cfg ver 20260315-1404)
Priya S.: cordoning gpu-node-12 and gpu-node-14; draining current pods gracefully
Marco L.: starting a canary for prefill-length-guard v1.2 -> 3 replicas
deploy-bot: Canary rollout healthy 3/3
Marco L.: adding a short-window (3m) alert on OOM count for gpu-infer-b
Priya S.: OOM count down to 0 in the last 4m after the config + cordon
Dana R. (CS): draft customer message: "We detected backend GPU memory errors caused by very large context requests. We've applied a temporary safety limit and are routing affected requests to a lower-memory fallback. No data loss observed. We'll follow up with a timeline and fixes." ok to send?
Ikuo N.: add that we enabled reject_on_prefill_oom to prevent cascading retries and that requests over the limit will receive a 413-like response instructing clients to trim context
Marco L.: follow-ups (post-incident):
- instrument seq_len and prefill memory histograms per-model/pool
- add configurable soft-trim + auto-summary options for very long system prompts
- surface provenance ids in prefill logs for faster audit
Priya S.: creating tasks: ENG-9021 (prefill trimming), ENG-9022 (seq_len histograms), ENG-9023 (auto-summarize prompts) and assigning to eng-runtime
incident-bot: INC-1839990001 marked mitigated by Priya S. at 2026-03-15T14:10:00Z
Priya S.: I'll write the postmortem and coordinate customer follow-ups. handing to next oncall: Marco L. is secondary
Marco L.: noted, picking up for rotation. thanks team :heart:
ops-bot: oncall handoff: Marco L. is primary for the next rotation
Priya S.: ending thread, filing post-incident doc now :memo:
